subject: Portal preflight: SSO test and evidence scope for Acme Payments
messages:
From: Tim Hargrove <tim.hargrove@acme-payments.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@acme-payments.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood access for vendor portal preflight

Rafael — thanks for taking this on. We're kicking off the vendor security portal onboarding for Acme Payments. Narrow scope for now: SOC 2 summary, control owner mapping for data retention & access controls, and a short SSO connectivity test to make sure our group can log into OneTrust.

High level asks: 
- Can Redwood provide a short SOC 2 summary and pointer to where we can find detailed evidence? (pdf or Drive link)
- We'll need a control-owner matrix mapping Redwood owners to the SIG/CAIQ controls we requested — acceptable as an Excel sheet.
- Can you schedule a 30m SSO test with our security team this week? ETA: Wed or Thu morning PT.

We can use the OneTrust profile linked here when you’re ready: https://vendor.onetrust.com/orgs/1234/profiles/5678

Tim
Tim Hargrove
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Payments

[Attachment: initial_requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Tim Hargrove <tim.hargrove@acme-payments.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood access for vendor portal preflight

Tim — thanks, got it. Quick reply with plan: 

1) SOC 2 summary: I’m attaching a short PDF that outlines scope & last audit date. We’ll provide the full evidence bundle through the Onetrust portal once SSO is validated. 
2) Control-owner matrix: PrIyom will own the initial mapping; we’ll attach a working spreadsheet for your review.
3) SSO test: Wed 22 Sep 10:00 AM PT or Thu 23 Sep 9:30 AM PT — please pick one. We’ll run through IdP metadata, user provisioning, and a sample login to the OneTrust profile.

Next steps: 
- Tim: confirm which slot works.
- Redwood: we’ll drop the SOC2 summary + control_owner_matrix.xlsx into the Drive folder and share.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_SAAS_Summary.pdf (PDF, 380KB)]

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood access for vendor portal preflight (internal)

Folks — I started the control-owner spreadsheet and included three tabs: 
- scope_mapping (SIG/CAIQ -> Redwood control IDs)
- owners (name, email, escalation contact)
- evidence_plan (what we will upload and timeline)

A couple of notes: 
- For data_retention controls, Monica should be the owner (she’s cc'ed on this chain and manages retention policy).
- For infra_access controls, I put DevOps (monica_patel@redwood.com) as primary and set PrIyom as secondary. 

I'll upload the draft to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D and attach the file for quick reference. Please review owners and suggest edits before the SSO test.

-Priyom
Priyom Das
Security Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: control_owner_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 52KB)]

Cc: security_ops@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood access for vendor portal preflight

Rafael — Wed 10:00 AM PT works. Invited security_ops and myself.

Couple of quick clarifications before the call: 
- Will Redwood enable test accounts scoped to the Onetrust profile?
- For the evidence upload, we prefer a bundle (PDF + an owner matrix); a Drive link is fine but we may ask for file copies in the portal later.

See you at 10:00.

—Tim

To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood access for vendor portal preflight (internal)

Great — thanks team. A few items to prep before the SSO test: 
- Monica: can you confirm the IdP metadata we’ll provide (Okta) and share a screenshot of the SAML settings? Attach to thread as onetrust_sso_screenshot.png.
- Priyom: please mark which evidence items are time-sensitive (SOC logs, retention configs) so we prioritize upload instead of placeholder notes.
- Rafael: confirm the Drive sharing ACL is set to allow external collaborators from Acme to view the two files. 

I’ll stay on the call and coordinate the portal upload after the test.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Tim Hargrove <tim.hargrove@acme-payments.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@acme-payments.com
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood access for vendor portal preflight

All good — SSO test completed successfully. A few notes from our side: 
- Test accounts logged in, provisioning worked as expected. Screenshot attached.
- We reviewed the control_owner_matrix.xlsx and had one request: add escalation phone numbers to infra owners (row 14-20).
- We saw the SOC2_SAAS_Summary.pdf — good first pass. We’ll mark a few items we’ll need full evidence for (syslog retention, KMS rotation proof) in the portal.

Next steps: 
- Redwood: upload the two prioritized artifacts to the OneTrust profile and copy the portal links into the Drive doc by EOD Monday.
- Acme: we'll flag required items in OneTrust and send a consolidated list by Mon 09/27.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Tim Hargrove
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Payments

[Attachment: onetrust_sso_screenshot.png (PNG, 120KB)]
